display.title: {"text": "I. Outpost"}
description: &6STATION I&r  Plant the charter, sleep at home, store what you find, set up a survey table and walk to the nearest ruin.
&eWhy:&r A home you respawn at, storage you trust, and a first lead pointing away from it.
&7- Sleep in a bed within 24 blocks of the charter&r
&7- Place 2 chests or barrels near the charter&r
&7- Place a cartography table (the survey station)&r
&7- Plant a crop or breed animals (reliable food)&r
&7- Step inside any roadside ruin, camp or settlement&r
&eUnlocks:&r A copper Construction Stick, a timber-and-stone building kit and a Surveyor's Chart to the nearest temple or arcane site.
&7Commission it from the charter panel. This quest completes by itself when the station records it.&r
&6You get:&r Workshop: press your first Survey Plates on a Create line.
